title: SETTINGS TAB FOCUS HAS NO HALO AND NO SECTION SLIVER
why: My own pictures after the last Settings ship: the focused tab still wore the global halo ring, a clicked tab left the list row lit with the focus bar, and the new section line showed a sliver of its hidden label. Now the tab shows only its bar, the list row steps back while a tab has the focus, and the line is clean.
now: Settings shows one clear focus and clean section lines.
